title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Argument… (CVE-2026-80261)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an Argument Injection vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially disclose sensitive information and cause limited integrity impact. The vulnerability does not affect availability and requires local access with low privileges. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported.
